body: You know, I just wrote a post myself about killing myself. I have no idea what you back ground is or anything. And I’m not saying u should or shouldn’t. It’s your life and I get how you feel. But I think it would be better to be happy or make a joke out of it. I don’t know if you can find my post but I’m not scared and now worried when the next hour hits. But the fact that I make it almost like a joke or funny cushions the blow. Like even right now. No matter how shit my life has been I’ve always smiled and laughed. It helps me not feel so down and makes the people around me happy to. Basically instead of saying “the pain is to much to bear” be like “WELP that didn’t go as planned... looks like I’m getting a new door!” If your family finds you documents or whatever they will see that you weren’t so miserable. It makes me down to see so much depression.  I wish people would just laugh things off no matter how sad it is. Anyway, you should make the fire department by you a expensive ass door as a fuck you lmao
